mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_transactions (id, account_id, amount, currency, direction, description, balance_after, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{accountId}, #{amount}, #{currency}, #{direction}, #{description}, #{balanceAfter}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, account_id, amount, currency, direction, description, balance_after, created_at FROM account_transactions WHERE account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY created_at, id
